_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

cap_now.basis: total manufacturing equipment capacity, units per month, approaching; all products and sites; copy only, never on the pad scale

cap_2026.basis: pieces of 800G and 1.6 Tb products per month the company expects equipment for by the end of 2026, over

cap_2027.basis: pieces of 800G and 1.6 Tb transceivers per month the company expects capacity for by the end of 2027, over

pad_unit.basis: drawing unit, a choice: one taped machine pad per 50,000 pieces a month; never printed

gill_sqft.basis: square feet leased at 1111 Gillingham Lane, Sugar Land

kirby_sqft.basis: square feet of the Kirby property, Pearland

cr4_sqft.basis: rentable square feet, 17331 Chimney Rock Road, to be constructed

cr5_sqft.basis: rentable square feet, 17433 Chimney Rock Road, to be constructed

tx_total_sqft.basis: computed: the four properties' stated square feet summed

to_build_sqft.basis: computed: the two Chimney Rock buildings summed

side_m.basis: computed: side in metres of a square of each stated area, two decimals

gill_len_m.basis: computed: kit warehouse length for the stated area at a 2 to 1 plan, a drawing choice

gill_dep_m.basis: computed: kit warehouse depth for the stated area at a 2 to 1 plan, a drawing choice

months_to_done.basis: months after the August 31st leases to anticipated substantial completion, approximately

months_elapsed.basis: computed: whole months from August 31st, 2026 to the run date

stake_pitch_m.basis: computed: side of the larger lease's square over months_to_done
